programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
香料密碼粵普
programme.desc: 從辣椒的火辣到肉豆蔻的辛香，從胡椒的辛辣到香草的芬芳，節目細膩呈現香料的個性與歷史，探討它們的特質，逐步揭開它們的神秘面紗，展現舌尖與香料交織的奇妙融合。

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粵
programme.desc: 節目主腦黎諾懿深入有機生態園，靜候拍檔龔嘉欣、王君馨、姚子羚到臨，並迎接既艱巨又極富挑戰的任務！置身唯美玻璃屋，諾懿正式委派任務，這趟行程的題目，竟是由零開始，創立獨一無二的Cafe！三女更要「獻身」當苦力，全方位起動打掃，為店舖開業前打造靚靚面貌。原來諾懿別有用心，要從打掃測試她們的個性？三美化身女漢子，確令諾懿刮目相看。經歷第一天的辛勞，嘉欣、君馨、子羚分別寫下創業路願景，立意為這店共同努力！

programme.title: 奇蹟小店粵
programme.desc: 一個傳承自黃飛鴻的跌打醫館品牌，第二代傳人李燦窩因為一個承諾，從師母手中接掌醫館，並秉承要懸壺濟世的教誨，以相宜診金為街坊服務。他還示範推拿技巧，原來推動方向的順逆，效用大有分別！此外，黃飛鴻的「無影腳」名震中外，李燦窩卻指其實沒有這門功夫，何出此言？走進深水埗一間跌打醫館，映入眼簾的是一片粉紅色，原來這是出於跌打醫師梁天柱對女兒「愛的表現」？肥媽即席請梁醫師替她治理腳患，卻擔心會出現尷尬情況？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 在美國，擁有非洲血統的公民佔總人口逾一成，谷主凱婷認為這族群帶有傳奇色彩，也深深影響現時流行文化，於是與拍檔開展對美國黑人文化的探索。凱婷由奴隸制度談起，這催化美國於十八世紀爆發南北戰爭，其後還衍生出「種族隔離」等歧視問題。直至民權領袖馬丁．路德．金出現，他推動「羅莎公車事件」與「向華盛頓進軍」的民權運動，讓美國最終廢除了種族隔離制度。此外，眾谷主亦會談到黑人流行文化在音樂、衣著、飲食方面的特色。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐示範了一道柚子沙律，不會浪費甜度不夠或水分不足的柚子。為增加沙律口感和味道層次，除了加入香草，還會後加烤得香脆的蝦皮、花生和椰絲。至於調配沙津汁，則會用她的黃金比例法。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 「美醜」定義各有不同，有人注重外表，為了展現最美一面，會將照片修飾到滿意後才於社交媒體發放；有人則認為相由心生，內涵更重要。節目組請來四位藝人作自我介紹，並進行二選一問答與才藝表演，小朋友對各人的審美觀感可有變化？劉展霆、李爾晨均選擇以事業為先，為何被扣印象分？黃洛妍的小提琴造詣，打動小朋友心坎；獲讚顏值高的陳星妤，表演魔術卻似有失分……經過這次體驗，孩子們都認同才華內涵可令人發光發亮，變得更美！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴一行人乘船前往伊王島，途中遭遇敵人，新幹線戰士中唯一能在水上作戰的鷗號出動，卻揭發九十九害怕被浪拋的弱點。為了克服弱點，眾人助九十九進行特訓，太晴以自身經歷開解九十九的弟妹。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 在兒童體適能教練Angel姐姐的指導下，大家首先為提升上肢肌力作鍛練。其中一個動作是雙手撐地並抬起臀部，再伸直單腳同時以手觸碰腳尖，主持彤彤姐姐直呼動作難度高！「WORKOUT 2GETHER」另一組訓練則可強化協調能力，既有原地踏步、側跨步等下肢動作，也加入了平板支撐等上身訓練，全面強化全身肌力。「動物好萌友」環節，這次介紹獅子魚與黃海馬兩種海洋生物，讓小朋友認識牠們的特徵與習性。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 兒童節，小丸子要求得到比平時好的待遇。但因為過份任性了，而惹怒了媽媽。男生們行為幼稚，經常進行各種無聊的惡作劇及遊戲。有一天，濱治拿著載滿水的水桶來玩，結果闖下了大禍。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國粵
programme.desc: 《野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國》聯合世界頂尖野生動物拍攝團隊，透過以年為週期的野外追蹤拍攝，為動物國寶留存具有歷史意義和科學價值的珍貴影像檔案。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 本港創科發展過往被指以學術為本，技術與需求脫節，科研成果難以落地。但經過多年發展，本港八間資助大學上學年知識轉移收入高達142億元，按年大增超過兩成。科研人員是怎樣將實驗室研究成果轉化落地，變成在市場上銷售的產品呢？本港研發總開支在過去10年間增長超過一倍，但當中近6成都是由政府出錢，工商界投資只有不足4成，遠低於於鄰近的日本、南韓和內地等，如何才能建構本港的創科生態圈呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主經網上報名參加出海釣墨魚團，準備轉帳時卻發現是個人帳戶，對方回覆亦有可疑？節目組向有關公司查詢懷疑被騙徒冒充一事。樓上單位漏水，樓下天花發霉發黑，還傳出陣陣臭味。樓上住戶疑似懶理投訴，一直拖延維修，當局卻建議樓下住戶調遷，樓下直言不合理！佘詩曼、譚耀文、陳煒等《正義女神》演員齊聚商場，與劇迷一同觀看大結局。《魔音女團》即將啟播，十六位練習生出席活動跟觀眾見面。劉洋組團帶粉絲遊雲南，送上花絮。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻：退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 音樂製作人張佳添與主持們打匹克球，並分享保持心境年輕的秘訣。他笑言預計廿年後才退休，期望開展第二人生後嘗試各種新興趣。張小倫回憶當全職運動員時壓力不少，愛釣魚放鬆身心。這位劍擊前港將退役後生活多姿多采，也期待將劍擊運動傳承下一代。不少人於退休後嘗試完成人生願望清單挑戰新事物，藍男夫婦體驗駕駛小型飛機；曾展望、葉蒨文學潛水之餘，還一圓賽車夢。此外，四人還在曼谷跟隨名廚學煮泰國菜與法式美食。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！歌手方力申本尊駕到試唱自家作品<好心好報；「星級」參賽者區永權、莊子璇也會接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 許志安出道40周年，回望過往，哪些歌曲能列入其「代表作」？他在這集選唱的<男人最痛、<我的天我的歌、<向全世界說愛你、<一步一生可會是答案？安仔的歌迷會會長攜來珍藏唱片，還獲機會向偶像提問，說出的卻是一個「要求」？安仔的新歌<信天翁，是他與填詞人林若寧討論下得出的作品，為何安仔笑言要與對方互相多多包容？節目還會倒數「勁歌金榜」，並相約曾樂彤暢談其轉型獨立發展後的第六首歌曲<愛琴海日記。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 大廚葉世昌師傅帶暉哥品嚐心水手工餃子，包括翠玉瓜雞肉魚湯餃、薺菜馬蹄豬肉煎餃配雜菌雞湯，不加味精，嚐到家的味道。食評家KC帶波波到訪一間隱世餐廳，細味頂級焗豬扒飯及苦瓜炒牛肉，食材高級，滋味升華！蕭欣浩博士推介元朗特色雞蛋仔，遍嚐豬柳蛋、薄餅及夾心蘋果肉桂等不同口味，鹹甜兼備，並細說相關「嚐識」。中韓混血兒李明憲帶伍倩彤享用正宗濟州料理，包括辣燉無骨銀帶魚，以及燒原條銀帶魚，肉質鮮嫩，鮮味十足！

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 空手道女子隊際形成軍兩年，已在國際舞台錄佳績，四將董依然、馬嘉敏、王思敏、譚棹而細訴彼此默契、個人與隊際的分別。全港十八區合球賽涵蓋小學、中學組，冠軍隊分享獲勝喜悅。跨世代棒球賽召集多支不同年齡層的隊伍，讓小學生與銀髮族同場競技。葉鴻輝、楊博文等健兒出席活動，宣揚運動共融訊息。本港籃球隊「香江猛虎」進軍CBA三人超級聯賽，有何目標？另搜羅本地帆船賽、越野跑愉景灣站戰報，以及國際象棋世錦賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
寒戰2粵PG
programme.desc: 經過「寒戰」行動後，劉傑輝（郭富城飾）雖然獲委任為警務處處長，但昔日的兇徒不僅逍遙法外，甚至將行動進一步升級，並綁架他的妻女，他除了要拯救自己妻女，同時亦要與身邊的同僚進行權力博弈。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主經網上報名參加出海釣墨魚團，準備轉帳時卻發現是個人帳戶，對方回覆亦有可疑？節目組向有關公司查詢懷疑被騙徒冒充一事。樓上單位漏水，樓下天花發霉發黑，還傳出陣陣臭味。樓上住戶疑似懶理投訴，一直拖延維修，當局卻建議樓下住戶調遷，樓下直言不合理！佘詩曼、譚耀文、陳煒等《正義女神》演員齊聚商場，與劇迷一同觀看大結局。《魔音女團》即將啟播，十六位練習生出席活動跟觀眾見面。劉洋組團帶粉絲遊雲南，送上花絮。

programme.title: 奇蹟小店粵
programme.desc: 一個傳承自黃飛鴻的跌打醫館品牌，第二代傳人李燦窩因為一個承諾，從師母手中接掌醫館，並秉承要懸壺濟世的教誨，以相宜診金為街坊服務。他還示範推拿技巧，原來推動方向的順逆，效用大有分別！此外，黃飛鴻的「無影腳」名震中外，李燦窩卻指其實沒有這門功夫，何出此言？走進深水埗一間跌打醫館，映入眼簾的是一片粉紅色，原來這是出於跌打醫師梁天柱對女兒「愛的表現」？肥媽即席請梁醫師替她治理腳患，卻擔心會出現尷尬情況？

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粵
programme.desc: 節目主腦黎諾懿深入有機生態園，靜候拍檔龔嘉欣、王君馨、姚子羚到臨，並迎接既艱巨又極富挑戰的任務！置身唯美玻璃屋，諾懿正式委派任務，這趟行程的題目，竟是由零開始，創立獨一無二的Cafe！三女更要「獻身」當苦力，全方位起動打掃，為店舖開業前打造靚靚面貌。原來諾懿別有用心，要從打掃測試她們的個性？三美化身女漢子，確令諾懿刮目相看。經歷第一天的辛勞，嘉欣、君馨、子羚分別寫下創業路願景，立意為這店共同努力！

programme.title: 香料密碼粵普
programme.desc: 從辣椒的火辣到肉豆蔻的辛香，從胡椒的辛辣到香草的芬芳，節目細膩呈現香料的個性與歷史，探討它們的特質，逐步揭開它們的神秘面紗，展現舌尖與香料交織的奇妙融合。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 情侶偶爾鬥氣「耍花槍」有助增進感情，如果弄假成真搞出「大龍鳳」便傷了和氣，大學講師廖舜禧、掌故專家鄭寶鴻分別細談兩俗語的由來。舜禧亦會講解源於桌球評述用語的「符碌」（僥倖）。手製小提琴放滿整間小店，場面令人「姥姥進大觀園－ 眼花撩亂」。張惠雅跟老闆學做小提琴，可會弄得「亂彈琴－ 冇譜」？年輕小伙子畢業後當上打金師，希望活化昔日香港傳統行業。精心傑作設計既新潮又富心思，絕非「金漆馬桶」， 虛有其表！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 維修鐘錶講眼力又考記性，鐘錶店老闆在上海街扎根半世紀，技術精湛，絕非「做一日和尚敲一日鐘－ 得過且過」！老闆還介紹店內擁有逾百年歷史的錶撞、錶座。香港製衣業曾興旺一時，出售衣車的商店開得其門如市；「衣車叔叔」細談行業興衰史。重陽節的登高習俗呈現中國傳統孝道，「佛山孝子」登高竟被視為虛情假意？「沙頭角村長個女」，到底是男是女？另外，中文講師廖舜禧試從中式建築學問解構人際關係，要做個有承擔的「架樑」！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐請杜如風、洪永城參與遊戲，還即場品評二人給她的第一印象。兩位旅遊達人見多識廣，很快就寫出答案，最終誰能勝出？曼谷婦女為何清晨便起床準備食物？台北燒肉店的「小鮮肉侍應」會提供甚麼貼心服務？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 為何首爾某咖啡店的客人總在手機中挑選相片？愛吃天竺鼠的秘魯人把天竺鼠放進哪幅名畫中？鄭丹瑞、米雪見多識廣，要答中問題並不難，只怕農夫在身邊搞破壞！曼谷有何特別造型的甜品令處變不驚的Do姐也不敢一試？

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 第一次星夢公主杯突然在彩虹天空區開鑼。偶像們先要挑戰預賽，再由頭兩名出線者進行演唱會比試。預賽內容是乘坐跳樓機不發出聲音，令害怕刺激機動遊戲的繪萌方寸大亂，而閃亮CHU想出來的解決辦法竟然是……

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 巨人隊慘敗給暴龍隊，多啦A夢拿出「前路指示器」，讓大雄按指示走尋找解決方法。爸爸要去攀登尖岳，媽媽表示擔心並反對，多啦A夢拿出法寶「護身符」，見大家對功效存疑，便先以大雄作試驗。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 飲食文化研究會不過是幌子，真相是詩音為了獲得活動室而隨便成立，連活動內容也沒有定下來。正當大家打掃好活動室，百無聊賴地喝茶時，校方職員竟突擊視察活動內容，還要求明天前提供學會有實質活動的證明……

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 周佩婷接棒遊上海，先帶大家減減壓。體驗過彈床、水床等輕量級設施後，她走進「破壞屋」發洩對導演的不滿！有古董發燒友自設博物館，收藏了逾千件珍品，佩婷換上旗袍細味舊物故事。現代商場內隱藏老上海大街，完美還原昔日情懷，並提供各式街頭美食。到訪網紅餐廳品嚐精緻佳餚之後，佩婷一試「高溫泥土浴」，不需運動亦可消耗卡路里？虹口區有餐廳主打鹹蛋黃美食，好邪惡！佩婷還闖進神秘後花園，與貂鼠、羊駝等動物近距離接觸。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 蒜子是不可或缺的配料，還具多種功效。肥媽將蒜子「升呢」主角，呈獻多道美食，還向農場負責人請教種蒜方法。阿媽用健康食材烹調「黑蒜蓮藕素湯」，雖因說錯姬松茸的名稱被6號「瘋狂抽水」，仍不忘提醒大家黑蒜連皮更有益！「蒜子雞髀菇燜雞髀」中的雞髀菇爽口腍身，也是精華所在。肥媽及後炒香蒜子，連同鱔片放於砂鍋內焗煮，「啫啫」聲不絕！阿6則以簡易步驟做出「黃金蒜片芝士薄餅」，兩種「重口味」食物搭配起來，格外惹味。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽在岸邊指揮6號登上小艇，隨漁民到塘中撈蝦，收穫甚豐。主持們把捕撈的南美白蝦帶回廚房，炮製「薯仔沙律」，還加入含有豐富膳食纖維的藜麥，增添口感。期間，阿6更自揭在法國吃海鮮的糗事。在家亦可炒出鮮香十足的「海膽炒飯」！阿媽教路要炒出粒粒分明的黃金炒飯，秘訣在事前準備功夫。她又利用真空密實袋慢煮牛仔架，令肉質保持粉紅嫩滑。阿媽還指導6號用電飯煲煮「紫薯糖水」，但她因何事突然大叫「唔好」及「救命」？

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖!粵PG
programme.desc: 「爸知弊幼稚園」以殘酷入學題考驗林盛斌、太太黃乙頤與幼子林道申(Jaye)，被問到爸媽二選一，Jaye口裡說「揀唔到」，身體卻很誠實……一家人透過繪畫讓專家分析心理，「校長」黎諾懿笑言解讀出Bob仍有生育想法？湊仔挑戰正式開始，Bob要單獨教兒子背出「3」乘數表，但零進展下只好試行洗腦教學！看圖搓泥膠遊戲，Jaye完成手作後一臉自信，Bob為錯誤複製作品向兒子道歉，Jaye道出甚麼令眾人爆笑？

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖!粵PG
programme.desc: 結識新朋友時間，外向的Bob偕幼子Jaye，與內斂的素人爸爸和女兒芊妤聚餐。Jaye細心發現芊妤衣服藏着一條薯條，打破寂靜局面！他還提到討厭Bob枕頭有臭味而被追問，即顯露出爸爸做主持的才能順利轉移話題。突然難度升級，Bob接獲太太乙頤指示再教兒子背熟「4」乘數表……陪子女溫功課好費神，兩組家庭溫習後比拼搶答測驗；Jaye太看重成敗，專家帶來小貼士！媽媽們驚喜回歸，Bob父子能否展現背乘數表成果？

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 梁芷珮和家人經新加坡轉機，首站未達非洲範圍，先抵「渡假天堂」馬爾代夫！芷珮預訂的渡假屋，位於水上，出門走幾步樓梯即可投進淺海浮潛。重點是租金包三餐，酒水亦隨意飲個夠本，隨教練前往團體浮潛都是免費。近海自然食海鮮，沙灘上享用海鮮晚餐，無調味亦夠美味！魚從何來？芷珮帶子女出海，體驗馬爾代夫漁民的傳統開住船釣魚法，最終有多少漁獲？淺水浮潛哪會足夠？芷珮還包船、包島玩浮潛、食海鮮，並於水中跟鯊魚見一面！

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 塞舌爾島是非洲收入較高的島國，曾被法國統治。芷珮一行人經杜拜轉機來到，先往當地的市場，看看有什麼手工藝品可當手信，收穫不少！與首站馬爾代夫相若，芷珮預訂的渡假村套房都是食、住、玩全包，帶小朋友到訪亦不成問題，因有兒童營地。免費出海玩帆船與親子槳板，隨意跳進水中爽一番！當地亦有不少本地團，眾人隨團坐觀光船，欣賞海底魚類暢泳，再登上只有一人居住的小島，探訪龐大的陸龜，還伸手撫摸，摸龜殼原來會觸動神經？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 每年一度的父親節，孝順子女都會落足心思，發揮創意為爸爸炮製驚喜。香港小姐邵珮詩向阿古(古嘉俊)請教特色甜品，讓她在父親節表孝心。阿古為了今次示範的「泰式香茅焦糖茶杯」落足心思，當中以朱古力製成的茶杯型外層，造型相當別緻。味道方面，他想出以泰式香茅融入西式風格，破格配搭凸顯阿古的非凡創作力。原來邵珮詩每年都有指定的父親節慶祝活動，不但過程有益健康，龍蝦與甜品更是當中必備元素，她跟大家分享溫馨回憶。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 文化祭將至，2年A班決定辦咖啡室，以阿茜的侍應打扮和良太的大宮拿坡里意粉作賣點，矢志奪得SOP獎。其間敵人來襲，E6和E7因維修無法出戰，幸好有阿天和紫苑補上，太晴用支援鑽地車擊敗敵人。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 結他彈唱的難度甚高，因為稍有唱錯、彈錯都很容易被發現。這集「My Little Show」就有一位勇敢少年前來挑戰，並透過兩首英文歌傳遞歡樂。四位型格小舞者送上充滿活力的精彩表演，還提到為了讓舞蹈整齊同步而緊密排練，更希望令觀眾留下深刻印象。音樂與美食都可帶來幸福感，結他導師將兩者合一，聯同主持們合唱兩首「美食之歌」，並暢談飲食喜好與習慣。導師還提起一個「空氣結他大賽」，背後理念是甚麼？

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 職業棒球賽季開鑼，學校的男生都熱衷於棒球的話題，但小丸子與小玉無法理解棒球的有趣之處。另一方面，小丸子爸爸也是棒球迷，為了看電視直播晚間比賽，導致其他家人看不到想看的節目。對此，一家人開始積累不滿。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近期有多個內地網吧品牌，先後來港開業，是甚麼因素吸引他們加入市場。美以伊戰爭開打，對香港的電子產品貿易，產生甚麼影響？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 城市不斷發展，原本生活在野外的動物，生存空間越來越少。例如在西貢，馬路越拓越闊，過路的黃牛成為車下亡魂；在金山郊野，餵飼行為改變獼猴的生存本能；一些爬虫類動物成為人類異寵，但最終被棄養，城市的發展和人類的行為，如何無意中改變動物的命運？究竟誰才是打破大自然規律和和平衝的不速之客？今集會走訪西貢、金山，了解一班義工及收容團體如何和野生動物「和諧共處」。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 新蒲崗有吹氣滑梯阻街？攝製隊到場了解後，發現……某家庭一家四口搬進新居，樓下伯伯投訴該家庭於凌晨發出噪音，並用震樓神器「報復」。男戶主特意在家安裝閉路電視以證清白，懷疑只是伯伯出現幻聽。伯伯仍然不服其說法，男戶主竟用兒女性命安全發毒誓！劉洋帶粉絲到雲南光顧其火鍋店，更點名推薦一款名為「竹蟲」的食物？另送上張與辰粉絲聚會活動花絮，提早慶祝母親節。

programme.title: 香港何濟公止痛退熱散呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 「快慢二重奏」下半場，即將引領觀眾投入節拍強勁的快歌世界。選手們維持既有的分隊組合，出場次序則會按上回的排名決定。五位參賽者縱已獲得晉級襟章，但仍全力以赴，為拍檔爭取出線資格。當這集的快歌比拼結束後，最終未能獲得襟章的十位選手中，將有兩人要離開。此外，評審們也會選出榮膺「快慢二重奏」的MVP隊伍。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 吳彥祖受電影導演梁樂民邀請，回歸參與港產片拍攝，拍過荷里活製作的他，返港演戲坦言「舒服」？彥祖透露拍這部戲前有諮詢家人意見，而當年是因「玩夠」故決定結婚？婚姻沒讓其生活改變，直至女兒出世，他才有大轉變？謝君豪、吳慷仁在片中合演首富父子，提到參考了多個富豪家族。「兩父子」一場掌摑戲令人深刻，君豪更即席「掌摑」主持王鎮泉讓他感受一下！慷仁做演員前曾打過數十份工，他又猜到君豪入讀演藝學院前的工作嗎？

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
叠影狙擊#20粵PG
programme.desc: 飛飛雖然保住性命，但是手腳癱瘓，勗杰和曉晨想盡辦法鼓勵他重新振作；文諾說服澤淮出面支持私有化，此舉反而令私有化計劃無法通過，正中文諾下懷；文諾得知俊雄的下落後，帶著曉晨去找他，怎料俊雄竟然叫她金夫人…

programme.desc: 結識新朋友時間，外向的Bob偕幼子Jaye，與內斂的素人爸爸和女兒芊妤聚餐。Jaye細心發現芊妤衣服藏着一條薯條，打破寂靜局面！他還提到討厭Bob枕頭有臭味而被追問，即顯露出爸爸做主持的才能順利轉移話題。突然難度升級，Bob接獲太太乙頤指示再教兒子背熟「4」乘數表……陪子女溫功課好費神，兩組家庭溫習後比拼搶答測驗；Jaye太看重成敗，專家帶來小貼士！媽媽們驚喜回歸，Bob父子能否展現背乘數表成果？

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 余思霆收拾好行李，請一日假便飛台北，獲地膽拍檔金剛接機，即搭機場捷運向市中心出發！旅程第一餐品嚐足料雞腿湯，未吃完已心思思要到寧夏夜市，尋覓同獲「車胎人」推介的芋餅、豬肝湯與蚵仔煎。日間於隱世咖啡店享用三層塔茶點，夜晚深入窄巷酒吧，啟動門口機關，走進以蜂巢為主題的設計格局並淺酌一番。翌晨，兩人排長龍買早餐，再登上公園邊賞花邊醫肚，偏黑色的滷肉飯有多滋味？下午行程有兩款選擇，歎啡、浸溫泉，悉隨尊便。

programme.title: 請1日假去旅行粵
programme.desc: 旅途第二晚，吃到盡！先有抵食海鮮加肉材一人一鍋，其他配料、蔬菜任添，再來意想不到的鹽酥雞當宵夜；連放鬆做Spa都有點心吃？第三日早上，兩大行程可揀，好動的可以滑水，金剛體驗「沙發滑水」，感受如何？愛靜的可跟思霆往赤峰街商圈做個文青，購物、打卡、來個小清新套餐。終極血拼階段，到永康街一帶尋找合適手信，台灣特色小食、茶葉、精緻生活小物，任君選擇。上機前再享用炭火烹製的薑母鴨，記住金剛建議最後才吃鴨肉！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 每年一度的父親節，孝順子女都會落足心思，發揮創意為爸爸炮製驚喜。香港小姐邵珮詩向阿古(古嘉俊)請教特色甜品，讓她在父親節表孝心。阿古為了今次示範的「泰式香茅焦糖茶杯」落足心思，當中以朱古力製成的茶杯型外層，造型相當別緻。味道方面，他想出以泰式香茅融入西式風格，破格配搭凸顯阿古的非凡創作力。原來邵珮詩每年都有指定的父親節慶祝活動，不但過程有益健康，龍蝦與甜品更是當中必備元素，她跟大家分享溫馨回憶。

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 周佩婷接棒遊上海，先帶大家減減壓。體驗過彈床、水床等輕量級設施後，她走進「破壞屋」發洩對導演的不滿！有古董發燒友自設博物館，收藏了逾千件珍品，佩婷換上旗袍細味舊物故事。現代商場內隱藏老上海大街，完美還原昔日情懷，並提供各式街頭美食。到訪網紅餐廳品嚐精緻佳餚之後，佩婷一試「高溫泥土浴」，不需運動亦可消耗卡路里？虹口區有餐廳主打鹹蛋黃美食，好邪惡！佩婷還闖進神秘後花園，與貂鼠、羊駝等動物近距離接觸。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 蒜子是不可或缺的配料，還具多種功效。肥媽將蒜子「升呢」主角，呈獻多道美食，還向農場負責人請教種蒜方法。阿媽用健康食材烹調「黑蒜蓮藕素湯」，雖因說錯姬松茸的名稱被6號「瘋狂抽水」，仍不忘提醒大家黑蒜連皮更有益！「蒜子雞髀菇燜雞髀」中的雞髀菇爽口腍身，也是精華所在。肥媽及後炒香蒜子，連同鱔片放於砂鍋內焗煮，「啫啫」聲不絕！阿6則以簡易步驟做出「黃金蒜片芝士薄餅」，兩種「重口味」食物搭配起來，格外惹味。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽在岸邊指揮6號登上小艇，隨漁民到塘中撈蝦，收穫甚豐。主持們把捕撈的南美白蝦帶回廚房，炮製「薯仔沙律」，還加入含有豐富膳食纖維的藜麥，增添口感。期間，阿6更自揭在法國吃海鮮的糗事。在家亦可炒出鮮香十足的「海膽炒飯」！阿媽教路要炒出粒粒分明的黃金炒飯，秘訣在事前準備功夫。她又利用真空密實袋慢煮牛仔架，令肉質保持粉紅嫩滑。阿媽還指導6號用電飯煲煮「紫薯糖水」，但她因何事突然大叫「唔好」及「救命」？

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

高朋滿座#89粵
programme.desc: 強訛稱慶兩個月沒發工資而不給家用，眾提議將他辭退。妙下定決心辭退強。但強知道此事後假扮在藥房內跌倒，令喜難以辭退他。受傷的強變本加厲，除向義索取保險賠償，四出借錢，最後更帶家人到藥房要求供膳。

programme.title: 尚食#29粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿要懲治蘇月華，孟尚宮自損雙手代月華贖罪，並辭去尚宮一職。災荒多發，瞻基對工部勞民傷財之舉十分不滿，下令減少宮內開支。子衿查閱宮廷帳冊，向太后指出負責採買的內宦貪污嚴重，並故意讓袁琦聽見。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚選購高級日本刺參，產自關東、關西的刺參各有何特色？鼎爺先示範「肉蓉釀關西遼參」，以豬肉、鮮墨魚、馬蹄等製作餡料，釀進已發透的關西遼參。記低鼎爺發海參的竅門。將釀好的遼參以上湯煨熟，上碟後淋上芡汁，滋味更佳。鼎爺與阿譚再到燒臘舖搜羅靚叉燒，製作港式「揚州炒飯」，亦以金華火腿炮製懷舊版「揚州炒飯」，鹹香美味。炒飯時宜先將蛋炒至半熟才加飯同炒，關火後才加入蔥粒，看鼎爺示範炒飯步驟。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 一項研究稱射精與可減低患前列腺癌風險或有關，泌尿外科醫生概述研究結果，還提醒男士如出現血精或小便帶血，應及早求醫。醫生亦詳析前列腺癌診治資訊，並建議多吃煮熟的番茄作預防。薛家燕回顧入行68年，感恩能將興趣變成終身事業。她憶述於《六指琴魔》反串一事，更難忘獲前輩梁醒波提攜！家燕姐從未演奸角，應大王所求首次擺出「奸相」。據悉她被長女「勒令」減少工作，可有其事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「酸蘿蔔豬肉湯」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 多項研究發現，男士出現脫髮的人口比率約20%，比例相當高。《醫度講》這集請來莊鍶敏細談如何受到脫髮問題影響，陳佔耀醫生則詳析脫髮的成因與治療方法。註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享有助改善脫髮情況的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#21粵
programme.desc: 春與九決定回到吳篤村前向嵐辭行，卻遇上食客鼓譟，九只得暫代大廚之職。食客對菜式大表滿意，南天王心腹李先生更邀請喜相逢成為佼佼鎮的代表參加「省港澳廚藝比試」。春問九如留在鎮中，會否介意被大家得知他是太監一事；禎特意請鎮中的字畫鑑賞家檢驗山的遺書，得知是偽造。禎用「調戲喜伯妻子」一事要脅，要關氏兄弟用轎把春抬回鎮中，眾鎮民看得大樂。禎跟蹤娣到廟寺，終得知她與揚間的關係。禎欲灌醉揚套取消息，卻只得知他甚痛恨山。揚帶禎談生意時遇見佟大貴；揚見合作對象竟是舊識後，突然要禎離開。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 撒哈拉沙漠竟會舉行馬拉松賽事？曾參與的跑者亮相節目，分享參賽點滴。跑者指沙漠近五十度的日夜溫差是大考驗，遇上沙塵暴時更是伸手不見五指。他還曾於沙漠迷路，幸藉輪椅選手留下的痕跡才抵達終點。他亦以自身經歷，寄語小朋友遇到困難要冷靜思考，尋找解決方法。嘉賓亦曾參與北極馬拉松，賽前在港於冰粒生產廠特訓，比賽時卻發現溫度截然不同？他憶述難忘比賽經歷，被一位十二歲少年跑者觸動，隨後亦成立了推動傷健共融的團體。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 麵檔老闆感嘆生意難做，多啦A夢借他「客似雲來喇叭」，誰知卻啟發胖虎炮製拉麵甚至開檔。為了讓胖虎一嘗真正觸電的滋味，多啦A夢把「充電衣」借給大雄，但後者卻沒有接地線，導致電力不斷累積。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 政府早前調高億元豪宅印花稅，對市況影響有多大？筆架山一個放盤質素如何？

programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

才駿Hashtag 法興輪證30週年粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2799粵
programme.desc: 因某些理由，家聰與卜卜脆互有嫌隙，偶然發現她的學歷似有可疑，經查證後聯同力蓮向Ceci揭穿謊言，詎料……Ceci待卜卜脆極好，引起不少猜測。若水等人提到一些發現，令某個說法更顯得言之鑿鑿。其後，家聰、力王發現卜卜脆遭人綁架，欲救人時亦一併被擒。綁匪向Ceci、敢威索取天價贖金，敢威打算報警，Ceci卻為救卜卜脆不惜任何代價。家聰認定卜卜脆跟Ceci關係非比尋常，遂想設法幫她，為此嘗盡苦頭……

programme.title: I LOAN U 網上貸款平台呈獻：重案解密#1粵PG
programme.desc: 無人商場發生孕婦被剖腹取走胎兒案件，因為人跡罕至和沒有閉路電視，重案組難以找出兇手，及後陸續發現兩具被遺棄胎兒；子瑤借故邀約美珍到家裡再將她打暈，打算取出胎兒，鍾琛及思怡到達，子瑤假裝自己也被打暈…

programme.title: 大生意人#21粵普
programme.desc: 古母質問李萬堂，眾人終於得知真相，原來李萬堂就是她當年失蹤的丈夫，也是害古平原考場被抓走的人。李萬堂決定終生留在寺裡贖罪，李欽認為是古平原和古母害他父親出家，表示要在生意場上打敗古平原，逼他一家消失。

programme.title: 海馬牌床褥呈獻：魔音女團粵
programme.desc: 《魔音女團》開學禮啟動！十六位練習生逐一現身集訓基地，訴說演藝點滴與「成魔」緣由。不少參賽者都想撇甩魔音標籤，全面提升「唱、跳、Rap、睇」魅力，企C位發光發亮，有人卻為結識朋友？主持蕭正楠、「班主任」陳潔靈、陳奐仁、形象指導馬天佑、服裝指導Kev Yiu、美妝指導Carrie Cammy、「助教」黃洛妍、冼靖峰、文佐匡，齊集與眾人見面，要將不可能任務變成可能，韓國偶像學院社長亦拍片向練習生打氣！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#19粵PG
programme.desc: 婉芳曾被游泳教練非禮，國棟懷疑色魔是泳會教練，到泳會搜查。國樑到泳會找情人胡德明，赫見國棟即躲起來。健碩查得攝影愛好者江永健曾替泳會拍宣傳片，懷疑他與強姦案有關。楊光突接Ada取消回港消息感失落。健碩等連日跟蹤永健，察覺他喜拍攝街上少女，國棟請婉芳協助引永健再犯案。永健果然色心暗起，國棟見永健有所行動即拘捕他。國棟獲炳基讚賞並推薦升任警司。可人心理全面康復，再投入談判工作。國寶成功投考警察。

programme.desc: 一項研究稱射精與可減低患前列腺癌風險或有關，泌尿外科醫生概述研究結果，還提醒男士如出現血精或小便帶血，應及早求醫。醫生亦詳析前列腺癌診治資訊，並建議多吃煮熟的番茄作預防。薛家燕回顧入行68年，感恩能將興趣變成終身事業。她憶述於《六指琴魔》反串一事，更難忘獲前輩梁醒波提攜！家燕姐從未演奸角，應大王所求首次擺出「奸相」。據悉她被長女「勒令」減少工作，可有其事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「酸蘿蔔豬肉湯」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 多項研究發現，男士出現脫髮的人口比率約20%，比例相當高。《醫度講》這集請來莊鍶敏細談如何受到脫髮問題影響，陳佔耀醫生則詳析脫髮的成因與治療方法。註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享有助改善脫髮情況的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#21粵
programme.desc: 春與九決定回到吳篤村前向嵐辭行，卻遇上食客鼓譟，九只得暫代大廚之職。食客對菜式大表滿意，南天王心腹李先生更邀請喜相逢成為佼佼鎮的代表參加「省港澳廚藝比試」。春問九如留在鎮中，會否介意被大家得知他是太監一事；禎特意請鎮中的字畫鑑賞家檢驗山的遺書，得知是偽造。禎用「調戲喜伯妻子」一事要脅，要關氏兄弟用轎把春抬回鎮中，眾鎮民看得大樂。禎跟蹤娣到廟寺，終得知她與揚間的關係。禎欲灌醉揚套取消息，卻只得知他甚痛恨山。揚帶禎談生意時遇見佟大貴；揚見合作對象竟是舊識後，突然要禎離開。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#89粵
programme.desc: 強訛稱慶兩個月沒發工資而不給家用，眾提議將他辭退。妙下定決心辭退強。但強知道此事後假扮在藥房內跌倒，令喜難以辭退他。受傷的強變本加厲，除向義索取保險賠償，四出借錢，最後更帶家人到藥房要求供膳。

programme.title: 尚食#29粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿要懲治蘇月華，孟尚宮自損雙手代月華贖罪，並辭去尚宮一職。災荒多發，瞻基對工部勞民傷財之舉十分不滿，下令減少宮內開支。子衿查閱宮廷帳冊，向太后指出負責採買的內宦貪污嚴重，並故意讓袁琦聽見。

Will they lead our protagonists toward growth or darker paths? As choices and consequences collide, this season explores identity, forgiveness, and change through gripping drama and unpredictable twists.

programme.title: Thayamma Yenna Kaapaathuu! - EP 1
programme.desc: Karthick Arthur is on a mission—first, he ditches Kunjesh (again), then charms Thayamma into letting him go solo. Destination? Serbia! From the heart of Jurong to the bohemian streets of Skadarlija, what’s waiting for him in this hidden European gem? If you're curious about what Serbia has in store for your next vacation—or just want to see what kind of trouble Karthick gets into—hit that play button now!

programme.title: Thayamma Yenna Kaapaathuu! - EP 2
programme.desc: Forget tourist traps—Karthick wants the full local experience! In this episode, he trades grand monuments for the everyday charm of Serbian suburbs. Join him as he hops on trams, squeezes into buses, and strolls through neighborhoods to meet the amazing people who make this country special. Get ready for a ride that’s as real as it gets!

programme.title: Uniki
programme.desc: Abhimanyu, a police officer solving the mystery behind the attack on Subba Lakshmi, a self-taught IAS officer.

programme.title: Netru Indru Naalai Season 2 - EP 10

programme.title: Dost
programme.desc: Vishwa and Raghu are the closest of friends, but nothing matters to Raghu except money. However, Vishwa is too naive to know that Raghu is a scheming villain who could soon ruin him for money.

programme.title: Thayamma Yenna Kaapaathuu! - EP 3
programme.desc: With a cool 16C breeze in the air, Karthick dives deeper into Serbia’s soul. From echoes of the Kosovo War to the grand elegance of Hotel Moskva, this journey is full of contrasts. But nostalgia hits hard when he starts craving home-cooked food—so what does he do? He fires up the stove and cooks a spicy sardine sambal, right in the heart of Serbia! Can he recreate Grandma’s magic?

programme.title: Thayamma Yenna Kaapaathuu! - EP 4
programme.desc: Next stop: Sofia, Bulgaria! Karthick kicks off his day with a local breakfast that tastes like a crispy prata wrapped around an apple pie—yes, you read that right! But that’s just the beginning. He steps into history at the only Ottoman-built mosque in the city, strolls through the charming streets of Bulgaria, and wraps up the day with a feast fit for a king...

programme.title: Abhiyum Naanum - EP 24
programme.desc: In the final stretch, the family moves toward a more honest understanding of themselves and of Abi. Old memories, hidden patterns and unexpected revelations reshape the way they see one another, opening the door to healing. As they return to the site of a defining loss, the family is finally given a chance to reconnect, not as they once were, but as they are now.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Treasure Trail
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa‐Laa and Po follow a trail of flowers which leads them to some very special treasure.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Feng Yu Song Chun Gui - EP37
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building - only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

It explores the country’s business, politics, technology, culture, entertainment and more. China 24 tackles head-on the issues that matter most to the nation and its people, with topical reports highlighting challenges facing this fast-changing country.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. programme.title: The Hub With Wang Guan

programme.desc: Chet accidentally trades all of the town's tomatoes to the devious Ace Gecko and the FAST crew has to outsmart the lizard in order to get them back. Skidmark has been secretly keeping a clamsquatch as a pet and it's up to the crew to protect the creature from a nefarious secret organization.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Dang, I'm Rich! Power Play
programme.desc: Cousin Ashley sets out to strike it rich and buy himself a mansion. Archibald explores Crackridge during a blackout with a new pal.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Big Pile of Cabbages
programme.desc: When Noddy comes to give Smartysaurus an invitation to Queen Sparklewings's picnic, there's a big pile of cabbages blocking her front door. Noddy investigates: who left the big pile of cabbages there and why? And will he be able to solve the case in time for the Royal Picnic?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Queen's Special Gift
programme.desc: The Knights have been away travelling around Toyland and they each return with a special gift for the Queen. But the last Knight to arrive back was so busy having fun that he forgot to bring back a present for the Queen. Noddy assures him the Queen won't mind but the poor Knight is adamant he must give her something. Noddy sets out to help him find the perfect gift.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case of the Pirates' Missing Treasure
programme.desc: When the Pockets find an old treasure map, the Pirates are delighted. They race off to find the treasure. Only to come back rather confused. They found a treasure chest but it ran away! Noddy investigates: "What's happened to the Pirates' treasure?"

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Frozen Toys
programme.desc: Noddy and Big Ears come to Fable Forest to see the Queen Sparklewings's magic crystal collection. But when they arrive at the Fairy Castle, they find all the toys there frozen like statues. What's going on. It's up to Noddy to investigate and help his friends return to their normal selves.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hare Hops
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hare didn't hop. He was one of the speediest animals in Tinga Tinga but none of the other animals wanted to race with him because Hare always won and it was becoming boring. Then one day, slow but clever Tortoise decides to challenge Hare.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Mosquito Buzzes
programme.desc: You see there was time when Mosquito didn't buzz. Mosquito was as quiet as quiet can be… and did she like to tell tales. One day Mosquito tells the Monkeys that the sun looks very low in the sky. ‘Maybe it's sad and doesn't want to rise!' worry the Monkeys.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Cornish Caper
programme.desc: Ted Glenn's Cornish cousin Ned is sending him a steam engine as an alternative means to power his workshop. Pat and Jess set off to Cornwall to collect this very large special delivery in the SDS Plane whilst Ted sets about giving away all of his old inventions to the people of Greendale in order to clear out enough space for the engine. Pat and Jess meet the eccentric Ned Glenn at his workshop and wrestle with the crate containing the heavy engine to get it aboard the plane.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Giant Pumpkin
programme.desc: Pat has to deliver some pumpkins to Greendale School for the annual Halloween Pumpkin Party. But when he picks them up from Ted's workshop, Jess starts playing with a giant pumpkin and it rolls into the river and floats away. Pat follows it along the river and tries to fish it out with Alf's rod but the pumpkin is too heavy and the line breaks. As the party gets under way in Greendale, the giant pumpkin floats out to sea and Pat and Jess board the SDS Orca and head out into Pencaster Bay.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - High-Tech Overload
programme.desc: Big Chris has got a new gadget to monitor the cars. He puts it to the test, what could possibly go wrong?!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Workshop Chaos
programme.desc: Big Chris is furious when Marsha tidies up his workshop - how's he supposed to work in these conditions? Luckily Flash saves helps out by messing it up again!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Shapes Up
programme.desc: Conrod is having an engine tune up at Silver Hatch. He boasts that his spoilers make him faster than all the other cars… who then want to be just as fast as their V8 hero…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Pit Stop Perils
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is fed up with Roary and Maxi constantly bickering about who is the fastest car at Silver Hatch. He decrees that the pair will have a race, and whoever wins, is the fastest - no more arguing!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Sleepy Toys
programme.desc: Everyone in Brickabuild keeps falling asleep and no one can get any building work finished. It's all because the lights keep coming on all night! Noddy decides to investigate who is turning the lights on. Bravely overcoming his own fear of the dark, he follows the clues to discover that the lights are being secretly turned on by a scared Carlton, who doesn't like the dark.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Secret Deliveries
programme.desc: Someone is giving presents to everyone in Toyland and all the toys want to say thank you but no one knows the identity of the secret gift giver! It's up to Noddy to investigate and find out who is it that's leaving presents for all the friends. By following clues and using his investigation skills, Noddy follows the trail to Animal Acres and discovers that Pat Pat and the Pockets are the secret gift-givers.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Little Lost Toy
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is delighted because a little clockwork duck has appeared at the DinoLab. No one knows where she belongs but Noddy is sure that her family must be missing her so he decides to investigate and find her home. Noddy uses all his skills of thinking, looking, listening and asking questions to find the home for the little duck.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of Jumpy Revs
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in Toyland. Lots of things seem to be jumping in a particular direction for no reason - Revs, Noddy's bell, Big Ear's spoons and kettle. What is going on? Noddy decides to investigate and help his best friend Revs who is very upset.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cupcake Tree
programme.desc: When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert Cakey to work together to shrink the overgrown cupcake tree branch by branch--and to save CatRat from where he's stuck at the top! For our COTD segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke

Now it’s up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Burst Tyres
programme.desc: There's a race at the loop-the-loop. Deltoid brings the prize for the winner: a beautiful model of the loop the loop circuit made by Pat Pat and Smartysaurus. All the toys are very excited, but before the race starts the tyres of Deltoid's tribike are burst! Could it be one of the contestants trying to prevent him from winning the race? Noddy needs to find out so that the race can take place.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Rhino Charges
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Rhino didn't charge and he couldn't see very well at all. Poor old Rhino really wanted to be invited to the Dance of the Horns up on the plains with Buffalo and all the other horned animals. But Rhino didn't have a horn, so he wasn't allowed. The Monkeys decide to help Rhino and make him a horn from a piece of old wood. But when Rhino wakes up he doesn't know what it is. ‘Aargh! Thing on the end of my nose! CHAAaarge!' And that's Why Rhino Charges.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Caterpillar Is Never In A Hurry
programme.desc: You see Caterpillar was never in a hurry. When all the animals were racing around Tinga Tinga getting ready for the Best-dressed parade, Caterpillar was happy to sit in a tree and munch on leaves saying ‘Po-le, po-le, slowly, slowly, good things come to those who wait'. Then one day the rains come and Caterpillar disappears into a cocoon. ‘What's happening?' questions Elephant. ‘Wait and see' says Tortoise wisely ‘Wait and See'.

programme.desc: Julian is very excited about the Sealife Awareness Day at Greendale School. While he's talking to Pat about it, his dad gets a call from Ben - a special delivery! Pat discovers it's a giant inflatable shark which is to be the surprise centrepiece of the Sealife day. But when Pat stops to help Alf mend a gate, a mix-up with parcel tape ends up with the whale accidentally inflating and floating off...

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Blue Flash
programme.desc: Pat must deliver Ben to Greendale School, dressed as superhero, The Blue Flash. But Ben keeps stopping to help people on the way and his costume gets increasingly ruined! Meanwhile at the school, Julian can't wait to meet his hero but Sarah Gilbertson insists that The Blue Flash isn't real... At last Pat arrives at the school with Ben wearing a new costume hastily cobbled together by Pat. Julian isn't fooled. Looks like The Blue Flash isn't real after all...

programme.desc: Roary is in a mischievous mood and keeps crashing into things. Big Chris has a great idea how Roary can burn up all his energy and be helpful at the same time!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Big Chris' Big Jump

programme.title: ONE GOOD TURN DESERVES ANOTHER - EP1
programme.desc: Young and beautiful Yee (Maggie Cheung) was held responsible for murdering a millionaire for his estate. She employed Shek (Chan Kai Tai) to defend for her. Shek was attracted to her mysterious background and fell for her seduction._x000D__x000D_It turned out that Yee was in fact the step-sister of Shek’s wife Shan (So Yuk Wah). She blamed Shan’s mother for taking her father away and she swore to take revenge. She seduced Shek and made him divorce Shan.

programme.title: Colourful Life - EP5
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape._x000D__x000D_The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA). The second son, CHI POK (YUEN SIU CHEUNG, LOUIS), is a short-tempered man.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP30
programme.desc: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires.

programme.title: The Conquest - EP23
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: Recipes To Live By - EP8
programme.desc: During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, Ding Yishan became a "hellish food critic" because of his "golden tongue". He was both an enemy and a friend of the famous chef Gai Zhaotian. At the same time, he fell in love with the cheerful Hu woman Shi Rou. They then competed in cooking skills to determine who was better in terms of "taste". Yishan accidentally discovered his background. It turned out that his biological father died unjustly, and Zhaotian and his son were also suspected.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP31
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP16
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP22
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Revolving Doors of Vengeance - EP22
programme.desc: Hotel tycoon WONG YUK TING’s family starts a legacy dispute immediately after his death. The third son KAI KIT (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) leaves home. His mother is soon forced to leave by his half brothers. Furthermore, KIT finds out that TING has transferred his hotel shares to a stranger KO FUNG, MARTIN (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE). _x000D__x000D_ FUNG comes for revenge. He swears to get hold of the whole hotel.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP31
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP16
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.
